title: N2 authenticated source-correlated first-attempt loss BOUNDS, read-only, scoped Actions
proof: For each accepted authenticated sender DATA PN window with complete local repair coverage, peer mature unique count U from correlated authenticated 128B V4 echo and sender successful original DATA count S, M=S-U. Any original source delivered by retry must have had >=1 selected same-wire repair attempt; R counts unique PN selected for repair before Emit (both pending and reserve paths; repeated attempts deduplicated). Therefore M <= first_attempt_missing <= min(S,M+R). If one record never arrived even via retry it counts M; if rescued by retry it contributes R. Local failures, 256 PN rotation during control, capacity and age cause INSUFFICIENT/STALE, never fabricated 0%.

constraints.per_repair_attempt: at most sixteen source report bitmask comparisons under existing lane lock
